name: The Pretty Thing Behind the Glass
source:
Reeve is the latest guard in an isolated containment facility where she is set to earn a handsome sum of money. All Reeve has to do is spend one week interacting with a highly dangerous entity capable of corrupting anyone and anything it touches. It has a long history of victims, and she could easily be next. Can she resist the entity's charm and earn the money...

...or succumb to its mesmerizing allure and discover that it is far more complex than she initially believed?

[Edited from [url=https://coolg1319.itch.io/the-pretty-thing-behind-the-glass]itch.io[/url]]
